settings.hookText: Claude Code doesn't write permission prompts to its session logs. This adds a {hook} hook to {settings} that leaves a note in {events} — it runs in the background and never slows Claude down. The file is backed up once as {backup}; nothing else in it changes.

settings.extWhySeen: Claude's turn counts as seen as soon as you switch to its window, so no notification comes for what you've already seen.
settings.extWhyReveal: A Claude session clicked in the day view comes up in its own tab or terminal.

settings.agents.missingText.codex: Codex CLI wasn't found on this computer. Once it's installed it shows up here and turns on by itself; you'll be told once.
settings.agents.offText: Claude sessions aren't followed: Claude isn't started from the terminal or the board, isn't counted, and its limits aren't read. Its hook and radio stay where they are; remove them if you like.

settings.agents.hook.trustOnce.codex: Once it's installed, you approve it in Codex once.
settings.agents.hook.waitingText.codex: The hook is installed. Codex doesn't run a new hook until you approve it.
settings.agents.hook.afterApproval: Once approved, this turns On by itself.
settings.agents.hook.workingText: Claude's state shows here the moment it changes.
settings.agents.hook.workingText.codex: Codex's state shows here the moment it changes.
settings.agents.hook.outdated.codex: A newer hook is ready. Installing it asks for your approval in Codex once more.
settings.agents.missingTextOff.codex: Codex CLI wasn't found on this computer. You turned Codex off, so once it's back it shows up here and stays off until you turn it on.
